description.value: Oku Izakaya is a Japanese izakaya located in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood at 2 Water Street, offering sushi, sashimi, hand-rolled temaki, and creative small plates alongside a curated sake selection. The menu blends traditional izakaya fare with inventive combinations — signature dishes include thick-cut braised pork, boldly spiced karaage, and smoked silver cod. It positions itself as a late-night destination with a cozy atmosphere evoking the spirit of a traditional Japanese izakaya.
